method.workload: 20 cumulative stages of a real Python ledger/CSV/SQLite CLI project
method.sessions: One persistent omp process/session per model; no history reset between stages
method.concurrency: Both model campaigns started together; Kimi continued after DeepSeek stopped
method.extensions_skills_rules_mcp_and_advisor: Disabled; startup asserts the six allowed tools and exact GenAI provider/model/base URL
method.execution: omp built-in file tools and a single allowed Python verifier command; generated application executed in separate real Python processes
method.verification: Independent cumulative expected results outside model workspace; real SQLite databases; no model-produced verification claims accepted as proof
method.thinking_caveat: Client requested off; actual formal first-hop logs show thinking=true. omp's compatible request mapping emitted minimal, which the proxy maps to a boolean on. This was not an off-versus-on comparison.
method.sandbox_caveat: OMP cwd and tool approval restrictions are not an OS sandbox; only self-created test data was used.
